decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Omniscience combo alongside cards like Chart a Course, Floodfarm Verge, and Meticulous Archive to quickly create a powerful board state. By controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Temporary Lockdown and Confounding Riddle, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent, ultimately leading to a win condition with Fallaji Archaeologist or Invasion of Arcavios. The deck also incorporates mana fixing with Adarkar Wastes and Seachrome Coast to ensure smooth gameplay and consistent access to its combo pieces.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the board through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage while setting up for a strong late-game win condition. By utilizing cards like Deduce, Stock Up, and Fountainport for card draw and filtering, along with powerful threats like Horned Loch-Whale and Beza, the Bounding Spring, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents. With a mix of control elements and resilient threats, the deck can adapt to different matchups and eventually grind out a victory.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Duress and Maelstrom Pulse, it aims to control the board while playing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Mosswood Dreadknight to pressure the opponent. Liliana of the Veil helps with discard and removal, while cards like Gix's Command and Go for the Throat provide additional removal options. The deck also includes cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to gain advantages and maintain a steady flow of resources throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Go for the Throat and Phantom Interference. The deck also includes cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to provide powerful threats that can quickly end the game. The mana base allows for consistent casting of both blue and black spells, ensuring that the deck can operate smoothly and efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption, leading to a fast-paced and dynamic gameplay experience.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost creatures like Novice Inspector and Warden of the Inner Sky, while using cards like Spyglass Siren and Regal Bunnicorn to control the opponent's board. The deck also aims to deal damage quickly with cards like Gleeful Demolition and Resolute Reinforcements, putting pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck utilizes a combination of white, blue, and red mana sources to cast its spells efficiently and effectively disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to create a strong control strategy by utilizing various cards that manipulate the opponent's resources and restrict their options. The deck focuses on controlling the board through cards like Day of Judgment and Ride's End, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Overlord of the Mistmoors to maintain board presence. Additionally, cards like Leyline Binding and Pest Control are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy and slow down their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and control the game until victory.

This control deck focuses on utilizing various cards to lockdown and control the opponent's board while building up resources and protecting key cards. It heavily relies on cards like Leyline Binding, Temporary Lockdown, and Zur, Eternal Schemer to control the pace of the game. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Day of Judgment and Get Lost, as well as powerful creatures like Overlord of the Mistmoors and Overlord of the Hauntwoods. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting spells and maintaining board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various spells and creatures to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Analyze the Pollen, Day of Judgment, and Get Lost, the deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield while slowly building power with cards like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Overlord of the Mistmoors. The deck also focuses on ramping up mana with cards like Up the Beanstalk and utilizing lands like Floodfarm Verge and Lush Portico to ensure consistent mana production. Ultimately, the deck seeks to outlast the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful creatures and spells.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By combining evasive threats like Spyglass Siren with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Hopeless Nightmare, the deck aims to control the board while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes Stormchaser's Talent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to provide additional card advantage and pressure. The mana base is optimized to support a mix of black and blue spells, allowing for versatility and consistency in executing its aggressive game plan.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering and removing opponent's threats while controlling the board and setting up for powerful late-game plays. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, board wipes, card draw effects, and high-impact creatures like Jace, the Perfected Mind and Overlord of the Mistmoors. It also includes lands that provide flexibility and mana fixing. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, answer threats efficiently, and eventually overwhelm them with card advantage and powerful creatures.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By using spells like Fear of Isolation and Hopeless Nightmare to disrupt the opponent's hand and deck, as well as efficient removal spells like Go for the Throat to deal with threats, this deck aims to create a favorable board state for its creatures like Spyglass Siren and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game quickly. The deck also features some card draw and tempo manipulation tools like Stormchaser's Talent to maintain advantage and pressure the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent while maintaining board control through the use of efficient creatures and removal spells. By utilizing a mix of creatures with various abilities and burn spells, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive strategy while ensuring consistent access to both red and green mana sources.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent, aiming to win the game before they can stabilize. With a high concentration of direct damage spells and efficient creatures, this deck looks to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and maintain pressure throughout, ultimately leading to a swift victory. By playing fast and aggressive, this deck aims to capitalize on tempo and board presence to secure the win in a Standard 1 vs 1 format.

The main idea of this combo deck is to utilize cards like Stock Up, Meticulous Archive, and Floodfarm Verge to quickly gather resources and set up the field. Once Omniscience is on the field, players can cast spells for free, allowing them to play multiple spells in a single turn and overwhelm their opponent. Cards like Oracle of Tragedy and Invasion of Arcavios help with card advantage and control, while Ephara's Dispersal can be used to counter opponents' threats. The deck also includes some removal options with Temporary Lockdown and Blast Zone to maintain board control.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Sunspine Lynx and Emberheart Challenger, combined with efficient removal spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to deal damage consistently and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Soulstone Sanctuary and Monstrous Rage provide additional reach and power to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Spyglass Siren and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and control the board with cards like Go for the Throat and Hopeless Nightmare. The deck focuses on quick and efficient plays to reduce the opponent's life total rapidly while maintaining control of the game through tempo and disruption.
